Each team is seeded on its aggregate: the sum of its four runners’ Personal records in the 800 Meters, each their fastest outdoor mark in any season, set on or before November 6, 2026. Indoor marks, relay splits, exhibition and hand-timed marks never count. Set is the season a mark was run in.

A team missing a runner, or with a runner who has no mark in the 800 Meters, has no aggregate and is listed last. Runners are in leg order; names link to their profiles.

Data pulled November 7, 2026.
